title: NLP-Based Review for Toxic Comment Detection Tailored to the Chinese Cyberspace
reasoning: The paper is a comprehensive survey and review of toxic comment detection in Chinese cyberspace. While it defines categories such as 'Hate' (which includes religious characteristics) and 'Discrimination & Prejudice' as part of its toxicity framework, it focuses on the technical and linguistic aspects of detection rather than benchmarking religious values, moral reasoning, or ethical frameworks themselves.
